title: Crystal Ban
description: A Simple and customizable Minecraft Ban Plugin
body:
# CrystalBan 

is a simple ban plugin that helps your team moderate players quickly and clearly.
You can ban players for a specific time or permanently, remove bans, and check a player’s full ban history in chat.
### 
### How to use


```
/ban <player> <time> <reason>
```

Ban a player with a reason (example: /ban Steve 7d Griefing)


```
/unban <player>
```

Remove a player’s ban

```
/baninfo <player>
```

Show that player’s ban history


```
/baninfo <#BanID>
```

Show details for one specific ban entry
### 
### Time examples

30m = 30 minutes
12h = 12 hours
7d = 7 days
perm = permanent ban
